title: Contacts and invites
summary: Shows which people in the phone's address book are on Bipe, so the user can start a chat, and offers an invite for the others. The server only compares the numbers and keeps none (ADR 0015).

person.description: displayName is the name saved in the address book.

joinedWithInvite.description: The person joined with the user's invite (GET /v1/me/invite-connections): bipe_contacts_joined_with_invite.

permission.description: The system address-book permission. notAsked: bipe_contacts_intro with bipe_contacts_allow. denied: bipe_contacts_denied with bipe_contacts_open_settings (iOS) or bipe_contacts_open_settings_android. limited: iOS limited access, treated as granted for the chosen contacts.

matches.description: Sorted by name. Empty after a check: bipe_contacts_none.

pendingInvites.description: Pending personal invites, for the bipe_contacts_pending_invites row.

phase.description: checking: bipe_app_contacts_loading. failed: bipe_error_network, or bipe_error_rate_limited on 429.

allow.effect: Asks the system for address-book access. Granted: runs check.

openSettings.effect: denied only: opens the app's page in the system settings.

check.effect: Reads the phone numbers of the address book, normalises each with normalizePhone (registries/phone-numbers.json), drops the ones that fail and the duplicates, and sends them in chunks of 500 to POST /v1/contacts/lookup. Each match joins the contact name to the user ID. Profiles and handles as in Person.

openChat.effect: Opens person-profile's message action: the DM, created when missing.

notes: The numbers leave the phone only for the lookup. The server compares HMACs with linked numbers, returns only holders who allow discovery, and never stores the list (api/openapi.yaml /v1/contacts/lookup, bipe/docs/phone-link.md). The app keeps no copy of the numbers it sent.

Limits: 500 numbers per request, a daily budget per account (lower for accounts younger than 7 days), 30 requests per hour. On 429, stop and show bipe_error_rate_limited. Check runs when the user opens the screen or pulls to refresh, not in the background.

Normalisation: normalizePhone in tools/lib/registries.mjs is the reference; cases in test-vectors/phone-numbers.json. Bipe logic: BipePhoneNumber.normalize (BipeKit), BipePhoneNumber.kt and BipeAddressBook.kt (libraries/bipe contacts).

The user's own discoverability is the discovery switch of Privacidade (settings-group privacy: bipe_discovery_toggle, PUT /v1/me/discovery with by_phone). It needs a linked number (GET /v1/me/phone); without one, the row says bipe_phone_not_linked. ADR 0063 plans three values (everyone, contacts, nobody); the API has a boolean today, so the switch stays until the API changes.
The phone number is for discovery only, never identity or sign-in (ADR 0015). No screen shows another person's number.
Parity: iOS built; Android planned (no address-book match yet, bipe-chat/bipe#162). Both new apps implement it.
